maya: Quick heads-up — ran a sparse-KV quant probe on 70B (decoder) with FP8-KV and INT8-KV profiles. Summary: FP8-KV reduces KV memory a lot but has small accuracy delta on long-context QA. Dumping microbench below.
liam: Nice. which dataset + prompt length?
maya: eval set = long-context SQuAD derivation (10k samples, avg ctx=6k tokens). baseline = FP16 KV + FP32 weights. configs:
```
- baseline: fp16-kv
- fp8-kv: per-channel dynamic, 8-bit mantissa-like hybrid (AWQ-style)
- int8-kv: symmetric q + per-channel scale
- kernel: fused kv cache + attention rewrite
```
maya: key numbers (median over 3 runs):
```
- baseline kv mem: 7.8 GB
- fp8-kv kv mem: 5.3 GB (-31%)
- int8-kv kv mem: 4.9 GB (-37%)
- p50 latency (1 tok): baseline 6.2 ms, fp8 6.4 ms (+3%), int8 6.9 ms (+11%)
- p95 latency: baseline 9.4 ms, fp8 9.9 ms, int8 11.8 ms
- p99: baseline 18 ms, fp8 22 ms (kv dequant spikes), int8 29 ms
- avg throughput (batched 8): baseline 120 tps, fp8 116, int8 98
- EM accuracy delta (exact match): fp8 -0.6%, int8 -1.7%
```
maya: interestingly, fp8 shows tail dequant noise with rare 1-2 token hallucination in long spans, int8 more consistent but worse avg latency.
arjun: can you share kernel logs for the p99 spikes?
maya: pasted a snippet:
```
[2026-02-14T15:12:03Z] kernel: kv_dequant_slowpath triggered 34/5000 samples (avg +120ms)
[2026-02-14T15:12:03Z] mmap: pagefaults localized to gpu-mem region 0x7f9...
[2026-02-14T15:12:03Z] fallback: auto-dequant path used -> temp FP16 buffer alloc
```
liam: sounds like FP8 dequant has jitter due to on-demand dequant allocs. two options: pre-dequant full prefix for hot sessions or async prefetch.
maya: did a canary profile where we pre-allocated dequant buffer per worker. p99 dropped for fp8 from 22->13 ms, p99 still slightly higher than baseline but within SLO.
```
- fp8+prealloc p99: 13 ms
- memory overhead (prealloc): +0.6 GB per worker
```
arjun: what's rollout plan? boolean flag to enable fp8-kv with prealloc and degrade-to-baseline when host mem pressure high?
liam: +1 for feature-flagged rollout. add metrics: kv_dequant_count, prealloc_hits, per-route p99.
bench-bot: run complete: 5000 samples, seed=42, model=70b-sparse-test, run-id=kvprobe-1962531111
ops-bot: FYI canary cluster has 16 GPUs; if prealloc increases memory we may hit evictions — need ops to check padding.
maya: note: INT8 gave better memory but required kernel fallback to scalar code in some attention patterns -> higher latency. AWQ-style fp8 seems best tradeoff if we accept 0.6% EM drop.
liam: can we run perp-token perplexity compare + human eval on 200 dialogues to see quality types of errors?
maya: scheduled a human eval job, ETA 48h. Also post the full CSV to S3: s3://redwood-ml/kv-probes/1962531111/results.csv
arjun: if human eval shows unacceptable semantic drift, we'll prefer int8 Kv but only for heavy-batch workloads where latency is amortized.
maya: next steps: 1) full bloom human eval, 2) internal canary with fp8+prealloc behind a route flag, 3) add auto-prealloc heuristic (hot session detection), 4) monitor kv_dequant_{count,latency} metrics.
liam: thanks — looks actionable. :thumbsup:
maya: pinging @eng-infra to reserve +0.8GB per-worker for canary nodes this week.
ops-bot: @eng-infra notified.
